entities.name: Andrija Žižić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Andrija Žižić is a Croatian former professional basketball player and executive. Standing of 2.07 m tall, he played at both the power forward and center positions. He is currently the sporting director for Cibona of the ABA League and the Croatian League.
